title: 127. Experimental Comparison of Nonlinear Stiffness and Damping Between Taylor Devices’ Pumpkin Isolators and Industry-Standard Wire Rope Isolators in 45° Angled Installations
summary: Taylor Devices’ PUMPKIN Isolators and industry-standard wire rope isolators were both tested in a 45° shear/roll angled installation. Nonlinear stiffness and hysteretic damping results are shown, including effects of input frequency and amplitude. The post 127. Experimental Comparison of Nonlinear Stiffness and Damping Between Taylor Devices’ Pumpkin Isolators and Industry-Standard Wire Rope Isolators in 45° Angled Installations first appeared on Taylor Devices, Inc. .
